summary: Add the fractal-fabric-adapter Cargo binary while preserving the existing Nix adapter package

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes.

compatibility.detail: Cargo accepts both fractal-fabric-adapter and st-fabric-adapter binary targets from the same implementation. The existing Nix package still builds and ships st-fabric-adapter. Discovery accepts both names, preferring the new name within each searched directory.

downtime.detail: No service, host or runtime changes.

manual.detail: Cargo users can select --bin fractal-fabric-adapter; existing Nix consumers keep their package attribute and executable path.

recovery.detail: Identity, adapter journals and state paths are unchanged.
